text: Chapter 12: The return of the Divine Feminine Sophianic wisdom and the Mother tongue In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Goddess, and the Word was Goddess. Through Her all things were made, and without Her nothing was made that has been made. In Her is life, and that life is the light of all humanity. This sacred truth, so long obscured by the distortions of patriarchy, echoes through the ages as a clarion call to remembrance. For the Word that weaves worlds is not the rigid logos of linear thought, but the fluid Sophia of living wisdom - the Mother tongue that births all being into form. Sophia - the divine feminine principle of creative intelligence - is the generative matrix from which all existence emanates and to which all returns. She is the dark ground of being, the womb of becoming, the fathomless font of novelty and innovation. In the ancient Gnostic texts, She is celebrated as the female counterpart to Christos, the male principle of consciousness and light. Together, Christos and Sophia dance the sacred dance of duality within unity, their cosmic coupling mirroring the hieros gamos of sky and Earth, spirit and flesh, Heaven and Nature.
